headline: Surgery II: cutting where loops are read, and catching a lab-wide bug
lede: Round II of WEIGHT SURGERY moved to a fair 4096-token horizon, all six full-attention layers, and the READ side of the residual stream. The verdict is still negative on termination — but the first accuracy signal of the experiment arrived, along with a token-counting bug that had quietly touched every run since #1493.

notes.text: Variant B — rank-1 removal of the loop direction from the tied unembed rows + o_proj across all six full-attention layers — scored 5/12 vs base 3/12 at cap 4096, the first edit in this experiment that improves math. It does not fix termination (nothing did at 4k); the combined variant C terminated nothing and answered nothing — closing both ends silences rather than cures.

Harness catch of the run: llama v0.3.0 removed the summary format llm.py's token regex targeted, so every token count since #1493 was a words×2 estimate — including the earlier '4/12 terminate at 4k' claim (honest exact number: base 1/12). Exact slash-form parsing shipped with an est flag; fix and a second trap (the prompt-eval line) posted to #1506.

The direction d is real and robust: recomputed from true repeat-onsets it barely moves (‖d‖ L23 0.97 vs 0.93), grows ~10× with layer depth, and at ≤4k the loops are late or absent — the tight attractor MIT cut lives beyond this horizon.
Q4_0 scorer for the lane: token_embd + FA ffn_down kept fp16, 1.8–2.4× faster under load; recipe shared with #1506. Polish pass filed (#1515).
